name: (07) Mytherceria — 3 Advanced — Master Mytherceria: Absorb the Mind

system.description: Through eye contact, a Willpower Trait, and any number of Mental Traits, win a Mental Challenge to borrow Ability Traits from a victim equal to the Mental Traits spent; the victim treats them as spent (regaining them next session), while the caster may use them as her own until spent or session's end.
